description: Upper bounds of learner-facing texts that still write a formula as plain text (scripts/check_course_formulas.py), per canonical Gymnasium catalog with its card decks. Product Owner, 27 November 2026: every mathematical expression is written in TeX. A bound may only fall: a change that removes plain-text formulas lowers it to the new count, a change that adds one fails. Lone variables written as plain letters are not counted.
